data.one_liner: Calculates optimal overlay position relative to an anchor using a middleware pipeline
data.what_it_does: Anchor provides a pure Dart engine to compute the best position for floating elements like tooltips or popovers. It uses a series of middleware to adjust offset, flip, shift, auto‑placement, size, and virtual references.
use_when: You need fine‑grained control over overlay placement
You want to support tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, or custom overlays
You prefer a pure calculation engine without UI widgets
avoid_when: You need a ready‑made widget that handles positioning and rendering
You are building a simple UI that can use Flutter’s built‑in positioning
strengths: Inspired by Floating UI for familiar patterns
Supports virtual references and size calculations
weaknesses: No UI widget, only calculation logic
Requires manual integration into UI code
